prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

An apparatus for cutting slab material comprising a working table to support the slabs to be cut during working; a working unit comprising disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means; and a unit for moving the working unit above the working table. The movement unit comprises a horizontal translation unit to move the working unit along two directions parallel to the working table and perpendicular to each other; a vertical translation unit to move the working unit along a direction perpendicular to the working table; a first rotation unit to rotate the working unit about a first axis, vertical and substantially perpendicular to the working table; and a second rotation unit to rotate the working unit about a second axis, inclined with respect to the first axis. Said disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means are integral and therefore the second rotation unit rotates simultaneously with the said cutting means.

outputs.L1: An apparatus for cutting slab material comprises: a working table configured to support the slabs to be cut during machining; a working unit comprising disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means; and a movement unit configured to move the working unit above the working table. The movement unit comprises: a horizontal translation unit configured to move the working unit in two directions parallel to the working table and perpendicular to each other; a vertical translation unit configured to move the working unit in a direction perpendicular to the working table; a first rotation unit configured to rotate the working unit about a first axis that is vertical and substantially perpendicular to the working table; and a second rotation unit configured to rotate the working unit about a second axis inclined with respect to the first axis. The disk cutting means and the water-jet cutting means are integral with each other, such that the second rotation unit rotates simultaneously with said cutting means.
outputs.L2: A machine for cutting slab-shaped material includes a worktable that holds the slabs while they are being processed; an operating head equipped with both a disc cutter and a water-jet cutter; and a positioning system that displaces the operating head over the worktable. The positioning system includes a horizontal drive arrangement that shifts the operating head in two mutually perpendicular directions parallel to the worktable, a vertical drive arrangement that moves it in a direction perpendicular to the worktable, a first rotary mechanism that turns the operating head around a first, vertical axis substantially normal to the worktable, and a second rotary mechanism that turns the operating head around a second axis set at an angle relative to the first axis. The disc-cutting device and the water-jet cutting device are fixed together, so the second rotary mechanism pivots both cutting devices at the same time.
outputs.L3:
The apparatus is designed for cutting slab material, such as stone, ceramic, glass, or similar sheet-like materials. It includes a working table configured to support the slabs during the cutting operation, ensuring that the material remains correctly positioned while machining is carried out.

A working unit is arranged in association with the working table and is equipped with both disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means. The disk cutting means may be used for mechanical cutting operations, while the water-jet cutting means allow cutting by means of a high-pressure jet of water, optionally mixed with abrasive material. The combination of these two cutting technologies allows the apparatus to perform different types of cuts according to the nature of the material and the required machining process.

The apparatus further includes a movement unit configured to move the working unit relative to the working table. In particular, the movement unit is able to displace the working unit horizontally in two mutually perpendicular directions, for example along longitudinal and transverse axes of the table. The movement unit is also configured to move the working unit vertically with respect to the working table, so that the cutting tools can be positioned at the correct height relative to the slab material.

The working unit is also capable of rotational movement. More specifically, it can rotate about a first vertical axis, allowing the orientation of the cutting tools to be adjusted in a horizontal plane. In addition, the working unit can rotate about a second axis that is inclined with respect to the vertical axis. This further degree of freedom enables inclined or bevel cuts to be performed and increases the versatility of the apparatus.

The disk cutting means and the water-jet cutting means are formed as an integral assembly within the working unit. As a result, when the second rotation unit rotates the working unit about the inclined second axis, both the disk cutting means and the water-jet cutting means rotate simultaneously. This integrated configuration ensures coordinated movement of the two cutting systems and allows precise positioning and orientation of either cutting means during operation.
outputs.L4:
An apparatus for cutting slab material, such as stone, ceramic, glass, marble, granite, engineered slabs, or similar sheet-like workpieces, comprises a support table on which the slab to be machined is positioned and a movable working unit arranged above the table. The working unit incorporates both a disk cutting device and a water-jet cutting device, so that the two different cutting technologies are combined in a single coordinated assembly.

The working unit is supported by a positioning structure capable of moving it relative to the slab. In particular, the structure provides horizontal movement over the surface of the support table, vertical movement toward and away from the slab, and rotational positioning for orienting the cutting tools as required. These movements allow the apparatus to perform straight cuts, shaped cuts, angled cuts, trimming operations, and other machining tasks with a high degree of accuracy.

The disk cutting device may include a motor-driven circular blade suitable for performing rapid linear cuts or cuts requiring mechanical removal of material. The water-jet cutting device may include a high-pressure nozzle arranged to emit a concentrated jet of water, optionally mixed with abrasive material, for producing precise cuts, contours, openings, or details that may be difficult to obtain using a disk alone. By providing both cutting means in the same working unit, the apparatus can select or combine the most appropriate cutting technique according to the nature of the operation to be performed.

A significant feature of the apparatus is that the disk cutter and the water-jet cutter are integral with one another and are mounted so as to rotate together about a common inclined axis. This inclined axis is set at an angle with respect to the vertical direction, enabling the cutting tools to be oriented in space while maintaining their mutual relationship. As a result, the disk and the water-jet nozzle remain coordinated during rotation, allowing the apparatus to carry out accurately directed cuts without requiring separate independent support systems for each tool.

The combined and jointly rotatable arrangement provides a compact and versatile cutting mechanism. Since the two cutting means are integrated into a single head, the overall structure is simplified, tool positioning is more reliable, and the amount of space required around the support table is reduced. The coordinated movement of the disk and water-jet cutters also improves operational precision, because the relative positions of the tools are fixed and known throughout the cutting process.

In use, a slab is placed on the support table, and the working unit is moved to the desired position by the horizontal positioning system. The vertical positioning system adjusts the height of the unit according to the slab thickness and the selected cutting operation. The rotational system then orients the integrated cutting assembly about the inclined axis so that either the disk cutter or the water-jet cutter, or both in sequence, can be brought into the correct working position. The apparatus can therefore perform a wide range of cutting operations with improved flexibility, accuracy, and efficiency.

This configuration is particularly useful in the processing of slab materials where different types of cuts may be required on the same workpiece. For example, the disk cutter may be used for long straight cuts, while the water-jet cutter may be used for internal profiles, curved edges, holes, or complex shapes. Because both cutters are carried by the same movable and rotatable working unit, transitions between different cutting modes can be performed quickly and precisely, reducing setup time and improving productivity.
outputs.L5:
**The Word That Said Everything**

The room was quiet, but the silence said more than any voice could. On the table lay a letter, folded carefully, as if the hands that touched it had been afraid to let go. At the top of the page, one word stood alone: **“The.”**

It seemed unfinished, almost meaningless by itself. The beginning of a sentence. The start of an idea. The promise of something more.

“What does it mean?” she asked.

He looked at the letter for a long time and said, “Maybe it means the story isn’t over.”

And somehow, that was enough.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for an apparatus for cutting stone slabs that combines a disk cutter and a water-jet cutter on the same movable working unit, including horizontal/vertical translation and two rotation axes.
counterfactuals.output: An apparatus for cutting stone slabs comprises a support frame defining a working area for receiving a stone slab and a movable working unit carrying both a disk cutting tool and a water-jet cutting head. The movable working unit is mounted for controlled translation along at least one horizontal axis and a vertical axis relative to the slab, and preferably along two orthogonal horizontal axes, to position the cutting tools over the working area. The working unit further includes a rotary support arrangement providing rotation about a first axis and a second axis, enabling orientation of the disk cutter and/or the water-jet cutter with respect to the slab surface for performing straight, inclined, shaped, or combined cutting operations. A numerical control system coordinates the translational and rotational movements and selectively actuates the disk cutter and the water-jet cutter, allowing rough cutting, precision profiling, internal contouring, and finishing operations to be carried out on the same slab without repositioning the workpiece. The integrated configuration reduces handling time, improves cutting accuracy, and increases versatility in machining stone, marble, granite, ceramic, or similar slab materials.

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the invention of a machine for cutting slab material where the cutting head includes both saw disk and waterjet tools, moves in X/Y/Z, rotates about a vertical axis, and tilts about an inclined axis.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention is a slab-cutting machine, such as for stone, ceramic, glass, or similar materials, equipped with a multifunction cutting head carrying both a rotary saw disk and a waterjet cutting nozzle. The head is movable along three linear axes—X, Y, and Z—so it can be positioned over the slab and adjusted in height. It can also rotate about a vertical axis, allowing the tools to be oriented in different cutting directions.

A key feature is that the cutting head can tilt about an inclined axis, rather than only about a horizontal or vertical axis. This inclined tilt axis enables the saw disk and/or waterjet to perform angled, bevel, miter, or complex cuts with improved flexibility and accuracy. By combining saw and waterjet tools on the same orientable head, the machine can carry out both fast straight cuts and precise or intricate waterjet cuts without moving the slab to another machine.

Overall, the invention provides a versatile multi-axis cutting system for slab materials, reducing setup time and increasing the range of possible cuts, including inclined and shaped cuts.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a European patent-style description of an apparatus for cutting slabs, specifying the table, working unit, horizontal and vertical translation units, and first and second rotation units for orienting integrated disk and water-jet cutting means.
counterfactuals.output:
**Description**

The present invention relates to an apparatus for cutting slabs, in particular slabs of stone, ceramic material, glass, engineered stone, concrete, or similar plate-like materials. More specifically, the invention concerns a cutting apparatus provided with integrated disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means which can be selectively oriented with respect to a slab to be machined.

In the field of slab cutting, it is known to use bridge-type machines comprising a support table for a slab and a movable cutting head carrying a circular cutting disk. Such machines are suitable for making straight cuts, bevel cuts, grooves, and shaped cuts to a limited extent. It is also known to use water-jet cutting machines, which allow the execution of complex contours, holes, and internal profiles with a high degree of accuracy. However, conventional systems often require separate machines or separate working heads, with consequent increases in cost, occupation of space, handling time, and machining cycle time.

The aim of the present invention is to provide an apparatus for cutting slabs which combines disk cutting and water-jet cutting in a compact and versatile working unit.

A further aim is to provide an apparatus in which the cutting means can be oriented with high flexibility so as to perform straight cuts, inclined cuts, bevel cuts, shaped cuts, and combined machining operations on a slab without requiring repositioning of the slab on the support table.

According to one aspect of the invention, an apparatus for cutting slabs comprises a support table configured to receive and support at least one slab to be cut. The support table may comprise a plurality of support surfaces, suction cups, rollers, or a sacrificial support bed, and may be arranged to keep the slab in a substantially horizontal position during machining.

The apparatus further comprises a working unit arranged above the support table. The working unit carries integrated cutting means comprising at least one disk cutting means and at least one water-jet cutting means. The disk cutting means may comprise a motor-driven circular blade, for example a diamond disk, suitable for cutting stone, ceramic, glass, or similar materials. The water-jet cutting means may comprise a high-pressure water nozzle, optionally supplied with abrasive material, suitable for carrying out contour cuts, piercing operations, and finishing cuts.

The apparatus comprises a horizontal translation unit configured to move the working unit with respect to the support table along at least one substantially horizontal direction. Preferably, the horizontal translation unit comprises a bridge or beam movable along a first horizontal axis and a carriage movable along the bridge along a second horizontal axis transverse to the first horizontal axis. In this way, the working unit can be positioned over substantially any point of the slab supported on the table.

The apparatus further comprises a vertical translation unit configured to move the working unit, or at least the integrated cutting means, along a substantially vertical axis. The vertical translation unit allows adjustment of the height of the disk cutting means and of the water-jet cutting means with respect to the upper surface of the slab. Such adjustment may be used to set the cutting depth of the disk and the working distance of the water-jet nozzle.

The working unit further comprises a first rotation unit configured to rotate the integrated cutting means about a first rotation axis. The first rotation axis may be substantially vertical, whereby rotation about said axis allows the cutting direction of the disk cutting means and/or the water-jet cutting means to be oriented in the horizontal plane. The first rotation unit therefore enables execution of cuts along different directions without rotating the slab on the support table.

The working unit also comprises a second rotation unit configured to rotate the integrated cutting means about a second rotation axis. The second rotation axis may be substantially horizontal or inclined with respect to the vertical axis. Rotation about the second rotation axis allows the disk cutting means and/or the water-jet cutting means to be tilted with respect to the slab. In this way, bevel cuts, inclined cuts, chamfers, and angled water-jet cuts may be carried out.

In a preferred embodiment, the disk cutting means and the water-jet cutting means are mounted on a common support body of the working unit. The common support body is operatively connected to the first rotation unit and to the second rotation unit, so that both cutting means can be oriented in an integrated manner. The disk cutting means and the water-jet cutting means may be arranged side by side, coaxially offset, or otherwise positioned such that each can be selectively brought into an operative cutting position.

The apparatus may comprise actuation means configured to selectively activate the disk cutting means or the water-jet cutting means according to a programmed cutting cycle. For example, the disk cutting means may be used to perform long straight cuts or preliminary cuts, while the water-jet cutting means may be used to perform shaped portions, inner corners, holes, or finishing portions that cannot be efficiently produced by the disk.

In one embodiment, the working unit comprises a disk motor for rotating the cutting disk about its own cutting axis. The disk motor may be supported by a tilting frame associated with the second rotation unit. The water-jet nozzle may be fixed to the same tilting frame or to an auxiliary support connected thereto, so that tilting of the frame changes the inclination of both the disk and the water-jet nozzle.

The first rotation unit may comprise a rotary actuator, a gear motor, a direct-drive motor, or a motorized turntable positioned between the vertical translation unit and the support body of the working unit. The second rotation unit may comprise a further rotary actuator, a gear transmission, a worm screw unit, or a direct-drive motor positioned between the first rotation unit and the cutting means.

The apparatus may further comprise a numerical control unit configured to control the horizontal translation unit, the vertical translation unit, the first rotation unit, the second rotation unit, the disk cutting means, and the water-jet cutting means. The numerical control unit may be programmed to coordinate translation and rotation movements so as to maintain the required orientation of the cutting means along a cutting path.

In operation, a slab is placed on the support table and a cutting program is selected. The horizontal translation unit moves the working unit along the slab, while the vertical translation unit adjusts the height of the cutting means. The first rotation unit orients the cutting means in the plane of the slab, and the second rotation unit inclines the cutting means when required. The disk cutting means and the water-jet cutting means are then selectively operated to perform the desired machining operations.

The apparatus therefore allows a high degree of flexibility in cutting slabs, because the integrated disk and water-jet cutting means can be translated horizontally and vertically and can be oriented by means of two rotation units. This configuration makes it possible to carry out a wide range of cutting operations on a single machine, reducing handling operations, improving machining accuracy, and increasing productivity.
